title: std::format
description:
`std::format` builds a string from a pattern with `{}` placeholders. Inside the braces, after a colon, you say how to lay the value out.

Write three small functions, each a single `std::format` call:

| Function | Example | Spec to use |
|---|---|---|
| `std::string price(double amount)` | `price(3.5)` is `"$3.50"` | `{:.2f}` |
| `std::string padded(int number)` | `padded(42)` is `"00042"` | `{:05}` |
| `std::string hexByte(int value)` | `hexByte(255)` is `"0xFF"`, `hexByte(10)` is `"0x0A"` | `{:02X}` |
hints: Each function is one line: `return std::format("${:.2f}", amount);`, `std::format("{:05}", number)`, `std::format("0x{:02X}", value)`.
